acceptance: TestTrainPlan_EjectsPRWhoseOwnCIIsRed: a PR with a red head CI is ejected with CauseHeadCI and no batch CI starts for it (red before the change)
A batch of green heads plans exactly as before (existing train tests pass unchanged)
fix: After verifyHeads in Train.Plan, read each head's CI with the existing PeekCI.Watch reader. Eject a head whose CI is red or missing with a new typed cause CauseHeadCI before any compose or batch CI; keep a pending head out of this batch without ejecting it. The ejection brief names the failed required jobs.
summary: 2026-11-20: PR #1582 had a red head CI, entered a 4-PR batch and forced a bisect (4 -> 2 -> 1, each a full CI run plus a rerun) that took about 3 h. Train.Plan (go/internal/integration/train.go:70) checks main's CI but never a PR head's CI; integration record-pr does not check it either.
title: the boundary batch tests a PR whose own head CI is already red, so one bad PR costs a 3 h bisect
